name: ultimattt
description: Tic Tac Toe: Classic, Ultimate and 3D Cube variants. Installable, offline-first PWA.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && node scripts/gen-preload.mjs && node scripts/gen-precache.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
scripts.check: node scripts/check-sw.mjs && node scripts/check-precache.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-theme.mjs && node scripts/gen-preload.mjs --check
